fields.options: Enable only the settlement methods approved for subcontracting. Method direction and safety requirements are fixed by the application. A configured method does not by itself authorise document creation.

fields.description: Allows an authorised Processor Lot user to override inherited method defaults with complete override evidence. It never enables a settlement document by itself.

fields.label: Require Resolved Ownership for Excess
